disposition_reason: Two hundred ten samples of 21 vegetables (10 each) from Sindh farms and Karachi exporters, 2007-2008, were analysed for cadmium, lead, arsenic and mercury; Tables 2-5 give mean ± SD per vegetable.

study.origin: farmers' fields in Khairpur, Sukkur, Hyderabad and Karachi districts, Sindh, Pakistan, and exporters at Karachi
study.method: HNO3/HClO4 (3:1) digestion; Cd and Pb by graphite furnace AAS; As and Hg by hydride / vapor generation AAS
study.qa: Duplicates; acid-washed glassware; no CRM, recovery or LOD reported
